design_philosophy.visual_style: Modern Arabic Minimalist with subtle Islamic geometric textures

rules: Use IBM Plex Sans Arabic for all headings and UI elements.
Use Cairo for long-form text or exam questions for better readability.
Ensure line-height is generous (leading-relaxed) to accommodate Arabic diacritics.
Never use italic styles for Arabic text (it reduces legibility).

usage_rules: Backgrounds must be Warm White (#F9FAFB) to reduce eye strain.
Primary color (#3A7D86) is for main actions and active states.
Secondary color (#D4A373) is for accents, badges, and 'Taqdir' branding.
Error color (#EF4444) should be used sparingly; prefer soft warnings for timer alerts.
Text must never be pure black (#000000); use #1F2937.

rtl_rules: Sidebar must be on the RIGHT side.
Progress bars fill from RIGHT to LEFT.

buttons.style: rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all duration-200

cards.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

inputs.style: rounded-lg border-gray-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary text-right

exam_timer.style: fixed top-4 left-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur border border-red-100 text-red-600 font-mono text-xl px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg z-50
exam_timer.behavior: Turns orange at 5 mins, red at 1 min.

login_hero.alt: Student reading book in calm setting

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary) are mandatory for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.screen_readers: All icons must have aria-label. Exam timer must announce time remaining at intervals.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SET DIR='RTL' ON THE HTML TAG. This is non-negotiable.
3. Use 'date-fns' with 'ar-SA' locale for all dates.
4. Implement the 'Exam Timer' as a sticky component that persists across scroll.
5. For the 'Question Management' CRUD, use a clean table layout with 'actions' column on the left.
6. The 'Student Exam Interface' must disable backward navigation. Use a linear stepper.
7. Use the provided image URLs for the login page and dashboard banners.
8. Apply the 'geometric_pattern' texture to the sidebar background with very low opacity (5%).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds; use solid colors or subtle textures.
Avoid 'Inter' font; use 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic'.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (positioned top-left for RTL).
Components must be responsive: Mobile (1 col) -> Tablet (2 cols) -> Desktop (3/4 cols).
